static_traits.name: Li Mei
static_traits.family_status: Living alone,住在Elementary school附近的公寓
static_traits.social_status: 有一位亲密朋友但尚not yet分享内心感受;尚not yet向同事透露担忧,担心被评判
static_traits.medical_history: without类似心理问题史;not yet接受心理治疗;No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度高;能具体描述时间与情境;Positive attitude但伴随明显Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: '我会被解雇'的持续性想法在刚开始家乡Elementary school的Work后出现,导致显著的Anxiety与痛苦,尤其在Before work和Work期间影响专注与表现.
basic_info.core_demands: The intensity of these thoughts and their impact on my daily functioning and mental health prompted me to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not competent for this Work

special_situations.event: 刚接受家乡Elementary school的Work后,尚not yet开始或刚开始履职
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能立刻完美胜任新岗位,就会被解雇
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我安慰并向同事寻求认可以获得确定感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might be fired within a week

special_situations.event: Before work and while teaching at school
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现not够好,do not人会认为雇用我是个错误
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Highly tense at work, pursues zero errors to avoid 'failure'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will realize hiring me was a mistake

special_situations.event: 收到Student,家长与同事的正面反馈但缺乏负面绩效证据
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面反馈not可靠;只有达到完美标准才算安全
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive information, filters for the worst scenarios in the mind, worries repeatedly
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些表扬not算数,我终究会被解雇

special_situations.event: 考虑是否向同事或朋友分享Anxiety时,担心被评判
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果暴露我的Anxiety与not确定,do not人就会看not起我,认为我not胜任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding disclosure and help-seeking, staying silent
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会评判我,觉得我not配胜任

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, to prove oneself competent and stay safely in the position
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判与拒绝,担心被解雇,被negate为'not够好'
defense_goal: 通过保持谨慎与not暴露脆弱来降低被评判的风险;寻求外部认可以暂时缓解not确定感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的新人,随时可能被淘汰的人
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻评判,随时会negate她的上级或同事

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others talk about others' evaluations, work performance, or whether to share inner feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向认为他人会像严苛的评判者一样发现她'not够好',从而拒绝或negate她(移情:Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以稳定,Empathy的语气验证其Anxiety;use开放式Questioning与Clarification事实,帮助区分推测与证据;避免对抗与评判.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请考虑向同事或朋友寻求支持,分享Anxiety时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为表达脆弱会给他人带来负担,并被视为not胜任,因而not应开口
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 温和探询'not给他人添麻烦'的背后担忧;以支持性语气鼓励小步尝试分享,强调可选择可信任对象与有限范围.

manifestations: Living alone,not yet向同事或亲密朋友分享内心担忧
在Work相关Anxiety中自我承受,避免求助

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Inner rules emphasizing one must perform perfectly
Treats 'zero errors = safety' as a rigid standard

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 担心上级或同事会认为她not胜任
害怕被评判而not敢分享感受

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 自我评价为'我永远not够好'
Excessively worrying and being cautious before work, limiting self-expression

positive_force: 收到家长与同事的正面反馈(Student喜欢她,家长给予好评)
Has one close friend as a potential support resource
Positive attitude,愿意尝试识do not与Reinforcement正面经验
能够清晰描述trigger情境与自动化思维
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的倾向显著
Perfectionism pressure leads to excessively high self-demands
Excessively seeks external approval but finds it hard to stabilize self-worth
Avoids sharing and asking for help for fear of others' judgment
Sleep and diet disturbance,影响日常功能与Work表现

target_behavior.behavior: 在Work前及Work中反复担心被解雇并出现Significant anxiety
antecedent: Thinking of possible evaluations by superiors or colleagues, worried about making mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: 新Work压力与完美主义驱动的Catastrophizing与预测not yet来('I am not good enough'核心信念被激活)
target_behavior.function: 逃避被negate与失败的潜在风险,通过寻求他人认可获得确定感
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep and diet rhythm disturbance;Work focus and performance affected;减少与同事和朋友的情感交流
